objective: Seek one bounded FUTO grant to harden Local Knowledge Terminal as user-controlled, local-first software without calling public source open source before an explicit license exists or counting an application or award as customer revenue.

program.published_fit: Grant programs fund projects and people working to challenge technology centralization; the page separately describes microgrants as internally selected and unsolicited.
program.policy: The current official page verifies that grant applications are open by email, but publishes no award range, deadline, geography, agreement, IP, payout, or tax terms. The proposed USD 5,000 request below is not a published FUTO range.

supported: Local retrieval and Qwen inference can run without a cloud API
Accepted knowledge is stored in SQLite and the graph is a rebuildable projection
Project-owned examples expose exact source spans, source hashes, reviewed relations, and portable JSON
The public offer and repository keep private collections, model weights, and generated data outside Git

license_audit.gate: Choose and publish an owner-approved license before accepting funding; do not describe source-visible code as granting reuse rights.

milestones.name: Licensing and rights boundary
milestones.deliverable: Owner-approved code license, third-party notices, corpus boundary, and public release checklist

milestones.name: Reproducible local lifecycle
milestones.deliverable: Raspberry Pi/Linux code-only install, update, uninstall, and offline smoke tests

milestones.name: Redistributable proof collection
milestones.deliverable: Synthetic or openly licensed starter data plus deterministic provenance validation

milestones.name: Portability and release
milestones.deliverable: Export/import regression tests, tagged release, operator guide, and bounded results report

submission_gates: Verify the exact sender identity and reply channel
Review the requested amount, six-week capacity, milestones, and exclusions
Ask FUTO to clarify geographic eligibility and agreement terms before accepting any award

funnel.policy: An application, reply, award notice, or promised grant is not customer revenue. Record received grant funding separately and only after funds settle.
